subject: Post-discovery: proposed cadence, demo windows, and evidence owners
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: proposed cadence, demo windows, and evidence owners

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and three asks so we can firm up next steps:

1) Proposed next meeting: 60-minute technical deep dive + demo. Two candidate windows:
   - Option A: Thu 9/16 10:00–11:00 PT
   - Option B: Tue 9/21 14:00–15:00 PT

2) Stakeholder shotgun: please confirm who from your side should join for security/procurement (names + emails) so we can loop them into a single invite. You mentioned a security lead and someone from procurement/contracting.

3) Evidence handoff: attaching a short discovery recap and our initial evidence checklist. If you can share the best contact who owns SOC2/network info, we’ll prepare a focused evidence packet to avoid back-and-forth.

Attachment: discovery-recap.pdf (summary of today's discovery and recommended demo focus)

If either slot works, I’ll lock the calendar and include our security lead (Kimberly Park) and solutions engineer (Marissa Cole). If neither works, tell me two preferred times and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — look forward to aligning schedules.

— Jonas
Product Solutions | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novamed.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@novamed.com>, Legal Ops <legal-ops@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: proposed cadence, demo windows, and evidence owners

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the clear asks. Good call earlier.

Quick answers:
- We can do Option B (Tue 9/21 14:00–15:00 PT). Please send an invite and include the security and procurement people below.
- Security lead: Tom Baxter (tbaxter@novamed.com) — I’ve cc'd him here.
- Procurement / Legal: legal-ops@novamed.com (they handle standard SOW/PO questions).

I attached a small CSV with internal compliance contacts so you know the right people to reach out to. Tom, if you want to add or correct any contact info, feel free.

Attachment: nova-compliance-contacts.csv (internal contacts export)

Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Partnerships | Novamed Health
elena@novamed.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novamed.com>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@novamed.com>, Legal Ops <legal-ops@novamed.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: proposed cadence, demo windows, and evidence owners

Thanks Elena — locking in Tue 9/21 14:00–15:00 PT. Calendar invite to follow.

Tom / Legal Ops — looping in Kimberly Park (cc'd) from our security team and Karthik Iyer from our platform team so we can cover:
- Security intake: SOC2 reports scope, data residency, encryption-in-transit and at-rest, and audit logs.
- Network/SSO: any IP allowlist or IdP metadata we should have ahead of the demo.
- Procurement: high-level commercial questions (term length, trial capacity, reserved vs hosted).

What we’ll deliver before the meeting (short packet):
- Evidence checklist (one-pager) — attached: evidence-checklist.xlsx
- Demo agenda tailored to your use cases (Jonas will lead the demo, Marissa will cover buying path)
- Proposed pilot cadence and success criteria (1–2 week pilot with defined evaluation prompts)

Tom, can you confirm whether Novamed needs a dedicated NDA or if the existing partner NDA covers this stage? Also, any constraints on internal attendees for the demo (e.g., only platform/security people)?

I’ll send a single calendar invite and a shared Drive folder for evidence exchange. If you prefer DocuSign for any preliminary paperwork, flag it and we’ll create the envelope.

Attachment: evidence-checklist.xlsx (what we typically need for a quick security review)

— Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@novamed.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Elena Ruiz <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal-ops@novamed.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: proposed cadence, demo windows, and evidence owners

Marissa / Jonas — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirmed for Tue 9/21 14:00–15:00 PT.

Two quick items from security/network:
- We will need an allowlist of Redwood demo IPs for any sandbox access. I’ve attached a small text file with our internal firewall team’s preferred format.
- For SSO, we use Okta; I’ll send SAML metadata prior to the call.

On paperwork: Legal Ops, we can proceed under the existing partner NDA for now; procurement will request a redline if we move to a paid pilot.

Attachment: network-allowlist.txt (format for firewall team)

Tom Baxter
Security Lead | Novamed Health
tbaxter@novamed.com
